name: Holy Cross, Karpaseia
description: A wall painting is recorded at Holy Cross, Karpaseia. The archangel Michael appears as a devotional figure in the church’s painted programme.

name: Archangel Michael, Choli
description: The recorded wall paintings of Archangel Michael, Choli include Joachim and Anna embrace, Mary enters the Temple, child Mary is blessed.

name: Christ Antiphonitis, Kalograia
description: Christ Antiphonitis near Kalograia is a domed church with several painting campaigns. Its decoration must be understood alongside damage, removed fragments and the archival photographs that record earlier states.

name: Holy Cross, Anogyra
description: The recorded wall paintings of Holy Cross, Anogyra include Dormition of the Virgin, Pentecost, Evangelists.

name: Holy Cross, Palaiomylos
description: The recorded wall paintings of Holy Cross, Palaiomylos include Dormition of the Virgin, Sacrifice of Abraham, women at the empty tomb.

name: Holy Cross, Kouka
description: The recorded wall paintings of Holy Cross, Kouka include Prayer in Gethsemane, Last Supper, Washing of the Feet.

name: Holy Cross, Parekklisia
description: The recorded wall paintings of Holy Cross, Parekklisia include Virgin and Child, Constantine and Helen, Communion of the Apostles.

name: Holy Cross, Agia Eirini
description: The recorded wall paintings of Holy Cross, Agia Eirini include Annunciation, Sacrifice of Abraham, Deesis.

name: Armenian Church, Famagusta
description: The recorded wall paintings of Armenian Church, Famagusta include Dormition of the Virgin, Annunciation, Baptism in the Jordan.

name: Archangel Michael, Vyzakia
description: The recorded wall paintings of Archangel Michael, Vyzakia include Raising of Lazarus, Annunciation, Last Supper.

name: Holy Cross, Kyperounta
description: A wall painting is recorded at Holy Cross, Kyperounta. Helena questions witnesses during the search for the Cross in later Christian legend.

name: Archangel Michael, Pedoulas
description: The church at Pedoulas contains Minas of Myrianthousa’s signed decoration of 1474. Its programme brings together the guardian archangel, sanctuary bishops and stories of Mary and Christ.
